quotations.old_english: Nǽnig deófolseóc ðæt he eft wel gewitfæst nǽre
quotations.english: no possessed person that was not in his right mind again

source_text: ge-witfæst; adj. Of sound mind :-- Nǽnig deófolseóc ðæt he eft wel gewitfæst nǽre no possessed person that was not in his right mind again, Guthl. 15; Gdwin. 66, 17.
